feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 5:25am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 14 November 2026 at 5:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

High pressure central Europe extending a ridge across the area, as low pressure developing to the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 later this morning, then touching 7 in places this afternoon. Decreasing south or southeast 4 or 5 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming moderate or rough this evening and overnight for a time.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, becoming fair this evening, then rain arriving overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers, then becoming moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, veering northwest 5 to 7 early Sunday afternoon, then north or northwest 6 to gale 8 later in the afternoon for a time.


##State of Sea##

Moderate becoming moderate or rough Sunday evening for a time.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, clearing later on Sunday.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor becoming good later on Sunday.
